object.description: Point the GUI's per-user application data folder at an empty folder and run with no standard error stream, as the windowed program does. Expected: the file logs\mellon-gui.log in that folder holds both errors, each with its type and message; exactly one unexpected-error dialog appears, and it names the first error and the full path of the error log file.
